meta_description:
390 likes, 14 comments - milindrunning on October 7, 2026: "On World Sight Day, I step into a reality that 1.1 billion people live with every single day. Blindfolded and guided through a simple room, I confronted what it means to lose the one sense we take most for granted.

90% of vision loss worldwide is preventable or treatable. Most people never receive the care they need, not because solutions don't exist, but because access never reached them in time.

For 30 years, Centre For Sight has been the name people trust with their vision. This World Sight Day, that trust extends to everyone who never had access to the care they deserved.

#WorldSightDay #CentreForSight #EyeCare #PreventBlindness #Vision".
